items.title: Here’s how a colicky piss-baby ‘celebrates’ Thanksgiving
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Kids today just don’t realize how easy they have it.

It used to be that if you wanted some batshit crazy in your life, you had to work at it. You had to get dressed, go down to the park and find . You know who I mean: the sweaty, unshaven one, with the dirty hair and the bloodshot eyes. He’d stand too close to you as he pressed a badly mimeographed manifesto into your hand, while going on about how space aliens had turned his uncle into a Buick Skylark, and how the government had documents that proved this, but were refusing to release them.

Ah, the good old days, am I right?

Oh come on, you joyless sack of shit, how deranged are you? It’s a holiday, and we’re all just trying to enjoy ourselves. Nobody wants to read this tiresome litany of bellyaching. Certainly not today. Life is too fucking short.

On a national holiday that’s all about getting together with friends, family and loved ones, and celebrating that time that the Original Americans chose willingly to help a bunch of struggling immigrants — — survive in a strange land, this vile, crabby old man, alone, no friends or family in sight, sits in his room in his vulgar golf motel, hunched over his phone, and does a racism.

“Most importantly, thank you to the murderers, drug dealers, and criminals of all shapes, sizes, and colors, who illegally entered our Country from other countries’ jails, prisons, mental institutions, and places unknown, to rape, plunder, and kill American Citizens in record numbers. They are mostly gone now, brought back to their point of origin.”

Way to truly learn the lesson of Thanksgiving, jackass.

If the Wampanoag tribe who helped the Pilgrims survive had their own Nosferatu McGoebbels, going ‘no! No immigrants! Send them back where they came from,’ he got outvoted. He’s been lost to history.

Wouldn’t it be great if our Nosferatu McGoebbels also got lost to history?

Donny continues to be the opposite of who we need leading us right now. Throughout America’s history, we’ve gotten it wrong so many times — slavery, anyone? Japanese internment camps? The Trail of Tears? Jim Crow? — but Thanksgiving is one of the instances we pretty much (almost) got it right. We need a leader who can celebrate that — not one who continues to divide us.

Unfortunately, being a racist asshole isn’t a high crime or a misdemeanor — but could the incoming Democratic Congress please please impeach the shit out of this clown, as soon as possible? You’ve already got more than enough reasons to.

Couchfuck McGee and his cabinet confederates are probably never going to 25th Amendment this fuckstick back to oblivion, so once again, it’s up to Democrats to make things right.

“It was just revealed that the REAL Numbers on the Economy, published before the Election, were FAKE, and a correction was issued yesterday by the people in the Government Agency that does these numbers.”

Goddammit, they’re not numbers, they’re numbers. That’s how it works. That’s how it’s always worked. The government collects data, put out numbers, and, as more data comes in, the number are revised, up or down. Twas ever thus, there’s nothing devious or diabolical about it.

Donny should know this already. He’s been head of the federal government for six out of the last ten years. You would imagine that at some point he would — at least accidentally, by osmosis — gain some understanding of how his own federal government works, but no. Anything bad that happens, it’s just more proof that the whole system is rigged against him.

It’s all so eternally exhausting. Donny raving and ranting about how the Commerce Department — headed by his own granny-starving oligarch, Howard Nutlick — is plotting against him is truly Red-Queen-off-with-their-heads territory.

Is there no way we can get that guy in the park — the one with the manifesto about the uncle who got turned into a Buick to run the country for the next two years?

How could he do a worse job than Preznit Fuckwit?

Later in the day, Donny and his contractually-obligated Slovenian green-card rent-a-wife made calls to members of the military.

Service Member: “What are you most thankful for?”

Trump: “We have the highest stock markets in history.”

There were so many possible answers to the question Donny had been asked. He could said he was most thankful for the beautiful rent-a-wife sitting right next to him. He could have mentioned his children. He could have spoke of being thankful for living in a country where a privileged, pampered white male moron such as himself could be allowed to fail eternally upwards until finally falling ass-backwards into a presidency he neither earned nor deserved.

But no, he made it about the . What a sad, tiny, unimaginative idiot.

We really need some palate cleansing right now, so let’s check in on the Obamas, and see how a real First Family spends the holiday season.

“Thanksgiving is a time to gather with family and friends in gratitude for all the blessings in our lives,” Michelle Obama wrote. “It’s also an important time to give back.”

The Obamas did what they always do — they . They didn’t hole up in a golf motel and bitch and moan about every fucking thing. They got out there and did good in the world. They’re an inspiration for the rest of us.

“Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa is spending Thanksgiving morning giving back right here in Central Texas. She’s teaming up with Meals on Wheels Central Texas and HUB’s Feast of Sharing to help deliver 2,000 meals this Thanksgiving to homebound neighbors across Travis, Hays, Bastrop and Williamson counties.”

Oh, and speaking of helping: two days ago I posted a link to a go-fund-me to assist the family of a woman who had been kidnapped by ICE to Mexico. As I sit here typing this on Friday morning, 64 of you have kicked in $2,619.

You people fucking rule. Thank you so much for helping to make a difference.

Let’s further palate-cleanse with some Daily Claudia.

Here’s Ms Spouse, three years ago today, on November 27, 2023, enjoying the brand new couch she’d found for us. Decorating truly was one of her superpowers.

Here’s another shot of Ms Spouse on her couch, keeping warm in the living room on a cold winter’s night, January 15, 2024.

Now let’s switch it up completely. Here she is on the beach in Narragansett, Rhode Island, on September 15, 2021.

Have a great Friday, everyone.

items.title: Things to be thankful for in these dark times
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
I spend 364 days of the year bitching and moaning about how everything is. Today, I want to talk about what I’m thankful for.

I only wish it could have been more — but 46 is a pretty good run, isn’t it?

because she’s very easy to brag about, and no parent could ask for more.

I’m thankful for my family, because they’ve been putting up with my crap for almost seventy years.

I’m thankful for my friends, because , I found a bunch of kindred spirits who are as weird as I am.

I’m thankful to be surrounded by an amazing, supportive communityof readers and commenters. I’m thankful for my readers, because without you, I’d be shouting into the wind. And I’m thankful for my commenters, because you’re smart and witty, and you keep me on my toes — any mistakes or ill-conceived ideas on my part, and you’re right there to school me.

I’m thankful that we live in this weird, fucked-up world where a cranky loudmouth like me, with no real plan beyond ‘Donald Trump is an asshole, and I’m going to troll him mercilessly on social media,’ can turn it into [gestures all around] .

I’m thankful that 2027 is bound to better than 2026.

I’m thankful for the massive tsunami that turned so many formerly red states and districts blue.

Look at these homies. I’m thankful for them.

I’m thankful that Preznit Fuckwit and his party shit their beds with such gusto that even this Democratic candidate, who lost by 43 points two years ago, and who didn’t have any money for TV ads, won her race this year.

The morning after the election, Victoria Broderick, a tech support worker in Fayetteville, Tenn., told her boss she needed the day off because she might just have been elected to Congress.

Ace job, Republicans — you built that!

That’s Rep. Robert Garcia, the Democrat who is now the incoming chairman of the House Oversight Committee. He can’t wait for January 3, 2027.

A federal judge in D.C. on Wednesday halted the Federal Communications Commission’s decision to call in ABC’s eight broadcast station licenses for early renewal proceedings, saying it was probably retaliation for speech critical of the Trump administration and therefore violated the First Amendment’s guarantee of a free press.

(From 2025) “Donald Trump and the cynics want us to believe that he is all-powerful, and that if you fight back you will lose. He wants you to believe that if you fight back you may face danger. And he wants you to believe that it won’t matter, because he is in control of everything — and it is not true. It is time for us to build not a resistance but an opposition — something that is durable, something that will last for four years, and beyond. And we need to build that opposition now, and we need to all gird ourselves for the long run.”

(From 2024) “I was not invited to my mother’s house for Thanksgiving. Apparently there wasn’t enough room. she said it was a ‘scheduling situation.’”

Oh, I see. a ‘scheduling situation.’ How fucking pathetic.

Imagine getting mad at because they allegedly prevent you from being an unstoppable fetus factory.

“I was at the bottom of my class. I started doing heroin, I went to the top of my class. suddenly, I could sit still.”

(From 2025) “Think about turkey. who really likes — be honest with yourself, Who really likes Turkey? You are all full of shit, everybody who raised your hands … turkey doesn’t actually taste that good. Chicken is good all the time.”

Who disses turkey in a speech to the troops the day before Thanksgiving? Way to shit all over hallowed American iconography, dumb-ass. What’s next? A soliloquy about how George Washington was actually kind of an asshole?

Hey, JD — is this your handiwork?

I’m thankful I’m not a ketamine-addled Nazi who fucked his own brand straight into the shitter.

And where’s Donny? He’s holed up in his unspeakably tacky Florida golf motel. He has no public appearances on his schedule for the rest of the week.

What a man of the people!

I’m thankful that I’m not in a cult.

I’m thankful that I’m not stupid enough to believe the asinine “war on Thanksgiving” drivel that Fox News trots out at this time.

From 2019: “Trump vows Thanksgiving name won’t be changed.”

Holy shit. Was anybody seriously worried about Thanksgiving being renamed Communist Martyrs Remembrance Day? I swear, Fox viewers are the most gullible fucking rubes in the universe.

From 2020: “They also turn their neighbors in, in China, in the Soviet Union. This is so un-American, and right now, just keeping your family’s Thanksgiving traditions is an act of civil disobedience. The home is sacred. what we do inside of our homes is our business, and I want the government out of it. And believe me, big government — Marxism — this is the one space they’ve been trying to penetrate for a long time.”

Covid protocols, that’s what they were whining about — in the middle of a pandemic that killed over a million Americans. Damn those Marxists for trying to keep you safe.

And, lastly, I’m thankful that I’m not a fragile fucktangle of insecurities who needs to be constantly ‘proving’ my masculinity via a series of inane stunts, only to have it all blow up in my face — or crotch, if you will.

Let’s do some Daily Claudia.

As I searched through my photo archive just now, I very surprised to learn that I never took a photo of Ms Spouse on Thanksgiving — at least not since the advent of digital cameras and phones. But I do have this, from our living room, nine years ago today, on November 26, 2017.

And I do have a shitload of photos from the vacations we took in Plymouth, MA, back when Katie was a wee lass. That kind of sort of counts, doesn’t it?

Here’s two-year-old Katie with her mom on August 24, 1993, on the beach in Plymouth Bay.

This one’s undated, also on the beach in Plymouth Bay.

Have a great Thanksgiving, everyone!

items.title: This stupid shit can’t even pardon a turkey without being an asshole about it
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
We all know that Little Donny Fuckface is a quadrice-indicted twice-impeached once-convicted popular-vote-losing adderall-huffing dead-pedo-bestie-schmoozing East-Wing-destroying insurrection-leading ear-diapering testimony-ducking judge-threatening lawyer-ignoring debate-avoiding witness-tampering crypto-scamming disabled-veteran-dishonoring insider-trading inheritance-squandering rube-fleecing clown-makeup-smearing language-mangling sneaker-hawking serial-sexual-predating draft-dodging casino-bankrupting butler-bullying daughter-perving hush-money-paying real-estate-swindling bone-spur-faking ketchup-hurling justice-obstructing classified-war-plan-thieving golf-cheating stock-manipulating weather-map-defacing war-criminal-pardoning horse-paste-promoting paper-towel-flinging race-baiting tax-evading evidence-destroying charity-defrauding money-laundering diaper-filling 34-count 80-year-old fluorescent-tangerine narcoleptic fart factory.

But do you know what else Donny is? He’s a loathsome old shithead who compulsively craps all over everyone else’s good time.

Let’s do that thing where I play a clip, and you try to guess what kind of event Donny was speaking at. Ready? .

“The price of gasoline also has dropped twenty percent in the last— two weeks. You notice it dropped right after the election? So, uh— I wonder if somebody had that in mind. A little strange. That happened with the covid vaccine, right? Right after the election they announced we had a vaccine.”

Okay — you’re never going to guess where Donny was, so let me just tell you. That was Preznit Fuckwit, pardoning this year’s White House turkeys.

Now, the turkey pardoning is a thing that every president has done since forever. It’s supposed to be a light moment of fun that kicks off America’s long Thanksgiving holiday weekend.

But Donny’s too fucking broken inside to ever have fun with . So instead of tossing off a cute little speech, he pisses and moans about every grudge and grievance. He gives the exact same whiny speech he always gives, in which he — the child of privilege who was born into obscene wealth, handed every opportunity, eternally bailed out and allowed to fail upwards forever, until he finally fell ass-backwards into the United States presidency, — is somehow always . Pity poor Donny, he always has it so rough.

This tiresome fuckstick can’t even pardon a turkey without being an asshole about it.

No one wants to hear that shit. Even the turkeys were like,

It’s so exhausting. I’m tired of being ruled over by these tiny little defective homonculi who can never let the country experience even the briefest moment of pleasure. Everything has to be a . Even our country’s 250th birthday party turned out out to be joyless piece of shit, because these people have no idea how to

I guess we should be thankful that at least Donny did manage to pardon the turkeys, after he was done whining. Acting President Stephen Miller would have probably just unhinged his jaw and swallowed them live.

That was Obama, back in 2016. It’s a cute little event that lasts about a little over nine minutes.

He’s got some super-adorable nephews with him, and he pretty much spends the whole time making corny dad jokes and telling awful puns. He’s having fun. The press is having fun. The guests are having fun. All of us watching right now, ten years later, are having fun.

That’s how you do it. That’s how you pardon a fucking turkey.

Oh, I’m sorry. Our current president, Shitticus J. Ratbrain, has more he wants to whine about. Let’s get back to him.

“We created, the day before the election, we created twenty— did you know that, Mike? We created twenty-five— TRILLION dollars in wealth. We lost about six of it, because of the election. If we would have won the election, we would have probably gained another six. But the twenty-five trillion’s a record. No country’s done that in such a— short period of time.”

I have a question. Where the fuck is this $25 trillion that ‘we’ created? Who’s we? If we’re all so rich, why did the Veterans Administration need to be gutted by the Space Nazi’s merry band of unfuckable DOGE incels? Why did USAID have to be shut down, if we’re rolling in that much dough?

Why can’t schoolchildren get a simple free hot lunch?

Donny, of course, is just making shit up. None of the numbers that just seeped out of his rancid anus-mouth are real.

Why does Donny have to be a jerk about everything all the time? Do you imagine he was in a bad mood because he had to pardon those turkeys for ?

But wouldn’t it be nice if we once again had a president who could just stand up and casually toss off a few bad puns, tell some corny jokes, pardon the damned turkeys and then leave us the fuck alone?

“Based on your temperament and commitment to being productive members of society I hereby pardon Peach and Blossom.”

Joe’s 2024 pardoning ceremony lasts just under nine minutes. He doesn’t tell as many silly jokes as Obama, but he’s clearly enjoying himself. He also gives his thanks and gratitude for having gotten to have a long political career.

What do you imagine Donny is thankful for? I’m guessing it’s . He’s a greedy vulgarian who imagines he’s entitled to — and whatever he’s given, Imagine being that broken, that you’ve never known a minute of satisfaction.

I’m thankful I’m not Donny.

Oh and by the way, I keep hearing about how all during the last year of his presidency, Joe Biden was icky and old and smelled bad and was so demented that he didn’t even know he was already dead. I don’t know, he’s sounds pretty alert in this clip. Oh sure, he loses his train of thought a couple of times, but it’s nothing like our current cognitively-collapsed president, who can’t go six words without tripping over his own rhetorical dick.

Why? What has Rudy Colludy done to merit this award?

This photo so perfectly encapsulates why everything right now. Here we have two grinning idiots, standing in the now completely-defiled Oval Bordello, in font of a portrait of the fuckstain who enabled our country’s long decline into oligarchy.

I’m thankful I’m not any of these shitweasels.

Andrew Ross Sorkin: “The president does own shares of Nvidia. Do you genuinely think that President Trump, in the instances of doing things for companies … that relate to stock that he may own, do you believe that’s what’s driving him?”

Jamie Raskin: “Well, if you don’t believe that, you're too innocent to be let out of the house by yourself.”

Seriously. This has been today’s episode of Stupid Questions, Easy Answers.

Hey, guess what: it’s time for our Daily Claudia.

Today we have a trio of Katie and her mom at the Shipwright’s Daughter in Mystic, CT, on July 10, 2025.

You’ve seen these three photos before, but I’m reposting them for a good reason.

The Shipwright’s Daughter is one of our favorite restaurants in the world. Ms Spouse and I would dine there at least once, every time we were vacationing in the area. But they don’t just do excellent food — they do excellent. Right now, they’re helping to promote a benefit and fundraiser for the family of a local woman who was kidnapped by ICE and deported to Mexico, separating her from her husband and three children at home.

Okay, enough of me droning on. Here’s the Daily Claudia.

Have a great Wednesday, everyone.

items.title: Donny’s corruption is happening right out in the open — because fuck you, that’s why
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
The thing about the Nvidia scandal is that it really has something for everyone. Do you adore crony capitalism? Are you charmed by tales of a horny CEO who can’t keep his dick in his pants? How about a Chinese spy running a honeypot operation, does that float your boat?

What about a greedy, insider-trading president who gives the horny CEO a free pass to sell restricted technology to China, in return for the horny CEO ‘donating’ a twenty-five million dollars, ostensibly to pay for the vulgar Epstein Dance Hall? That shit’s cool, isn’t it?

But wait, there’s more. We also have that same president shamelessly thumbing his nose in our faces about how openly corrupt he is, because .

CNBC: Without your intervention, do you think Huang would've been put back in his post by the board?

TRUMP: The answer is no. I believe my intervention was very important.

So there we all were, yesterday morning, just hoping to make it though the day in one piece, when , we got blindsided by a shit-blizzard of fuckery.

In rapid order, we first learned that Nvidia had rehired Jensen Huang to be their horny CEO. Next, we found out that it was none other than Preznit Fuckwit who had personally phoned up the board of Nvidia and strong-armed them into re-hiring Huang. Third, we learned that Donny is even more of a national security nightmare than we ever imagined.

“He’s in the business of selling chips. As far as the woman is concerned, every time you have a Chinese woman that’s good-looking or beautiful, they say she’s a spy. Now with Swalwell, she probably was a spy. But with Jensen, I don’t believe that’s true. But if he sold, I don’t even know what they sold. If they sold to the company she’s with, that’s standard.”

Before the scandal broke into public view, advisers to Mr. Trump told him on at least two occasions that U.S. intelligence had uncovered Ms. Huang’s links to the Chinese spy agency and that she was in a close relationship with Mr. Huang while he was still running Nvidia, according to U.S. officials with direct knowledge of the briefings.

Holy shit, those are some serious allegations. I’ll bet when Donny was clued in, he sprang right into action, taking steps to tighten up national security, to keep US tech from falling into Chinese hands, like few thought possible.

Spoiler alert: oh please, Dear Leader didn’t do shit.

Both times, including when his national security adviser discussed it with him, the president downplayed the concerns and made clear he did not want to intervene in the matter. The officials said Mr. Trump regarded Mr. Huang as a valuable ally and Nvidia as essential to the health of the American economy and stock market.

Donny let the spy allegations slide because the horny CEO was his .

I have a question: why do Donny’s friends always ?

Remember, the horny CEO had done Donny a solid, by ‘donating’ $25 million for the construction of the vulgar Epstein Dance Hall. And so Donny did the horny CEO a solid in return, by keeping his mouth shut about the Chinese spy allegations, and by allowing the horny CEO to go through with his plan to sell restricted chip technology to China.

The company won a huge victory late Monday afternoon, when Mr. Trump declared on his social media account that he was freeing Nvidia to sell its second most powerful chip, known as the H200, to China.

Isn’t it great how these oligarchs are always doing cool favors for each other, while We the People get cordially invited to go fuck ourselves, if we dare to ask for affordable healthcare? It really warms the cockles of one’s heart, let me tell you.

Oh, and then there’s this: Donny’s personally invested in Nvidia, and rakes in a shitload every time their stock spikes. In fact, Donny enriched himself to the tune of fifteen mil yesterday, by getting the board of Nvidia to announce the re-hiring of Jensen Huang as their CEO

You would imagine that there would be laws to prevent a president from manipulating the markets for his own personal gain, am I right? Well, of course, there — but there I go again, nattering on about stupid little things like , when Donny is A Very Special Boy Who Gets To Do Whatever The Fuck He Wants.

This piece of shit rat bastard cares more about his own greedy self than he does about the national security of the country he’s somehow managed to sleaze his way back into presiding over.

I can’t fucking even. I’m going to burst a blood vessel over this.

Excuse me while I go scream into a pillow for about five minutes. Here’s a cute kitten gif to stare at until I get back.

Wouldn’t it be great it we had a president who at least had the decency to pull this shameful skullduggery in the shadows, where it belongs? Of course, we don’t. We have a shithole president who thinks he just did an amazing thing, and so he showed up on CNBC, to take a victory lap. This corrupt fuckhead thinks he’s earned a cookie.

“I’ve seen some unbelievably talented CEOs get thrown out because they were kissing somebody inappropriately at a game or something. They never got somebody back who was at good.”

Listen to Jabba the Fuckface, casually dismissing predatory behavior as if it were just another day at the office. ‘When you’re a CEO, they let you.’

Oh sure, who among us hasn’t been honeypotted by a Chinese agent? It happens too many times to count, am I right?

Even Jimi Hendrix had that memorable line in Purple Haze, ‘scuse me while I fuck this spy.’

Tell me, allowing a crony to pal around with a possible spy, because doing so is a thing you’ll personally profit off of — is that a high crime, or a misdemeanor? Or has Donny invented some new kind of offense?

I guess it will be up to the next Democratic Congress to suss that out, at Donny’s upcoming impeachment trial.

Oh, and then there’s this — yesterday’s Crowning Moment of What In The Actual Fuck.

Is this supposed to be funny? Inspirational?

Donny’s brain is fried. I don’t even think he knows why he’s mocking his own Miracle of the Magical Ear Nicking.

Everything fucking sucks right now, but at least we can enjoy Fox News found object Jesse Watters being a fucking idiot.

“If Oppenheimer was caught sleeping with a beautiful Japanese woman, and she was secretly passing secrets to the emperor, should Truman have fired him?”

Oppenheimer WAS caught sleeping with Communist Jean Tatlock. His security clearance was pulled and he was put on trial, essentially “fired”. Waters hypothetical basically happened.

That’s right, Oppenheimer get caught pulling a scuse-me-while-I-fuck-this-commie — and they yanked his security clearance and sent him packing.

That’s enough for one day. Let’s Daily Claudia ourselves the hell out of here, what do you say?

Here’s Ms Spouse at the Peekskill waterfront on September 5, 2016.

And here’s some patio cocktail hour on June 2, 2025.

Have a great Tuesday, everyone.

items.title: Let’s all watch a Donny impersonator in Canada mock the shit out of Preznit Fuckwit
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Let’s start today’s post with a bang, and put our Hero of the Day right up top.

Saturday night, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney spoke at the annual Parliamentary Press Gallery Dinner in Ottawa — and he brought a ringer with him: comedian Mark Critch, who spent three awesome minutes mocking the shit out of Donny Convict.

“He’s got a great ass, doesn’t he? What a beautiful ass. He’s got such an incredible ass.”

Critch nailed it. He had the inane ‘jacking off two invisible giraffes’ dance down pat.

He did the infantile handshake, too.

And he had Donny’s moronic growly vocal cadences down, as well as his ability to speak in circles while saying absolutely nothing.

“And we’re going to have a deal, though. We’re gonna have a dear, aren’t we? Mark, we’re going to have an incredible deal. I call him— Mark. I don’t call him the governor to his face, because I’m a coward. But we’re going to have— A GREAT DEAL. There’s only one thing standing in the way. Me. Because I’m crazy. But that’s okay.”

“Damn. This is a tough room. And I’ve been in the Oval Office. Alone. With its new interior decorator.”

Oh look, Canada is openly mocking us now. Canada — the most polite country on the planet.

Apparently, as far as I can tell, Canada hasn’t been nuked yet. So I guess that the diaper nurse has somehow kept Dear Leader from seeing these clips.

Congratulations are in order to Donny — he’s an international laughingstock.

Donny never shuts the fuck up about how much everyone respects him, when the reality is that nothing could be further from the truth. He’s an easily-parodied sideshow clown who prances about in ill-fitting clothes, with that ridiculous rat’s nest of what the fuck even is that stapled to his big, dumb pumpkin head, along with his rotting hands, bloated cankles, and whatever the hell is creating that bulge in his ass. And let’s never forget that voluptuous neckgina.

So no, no one in the world is Dear Leader. And no one is his , either. Not Putin, and certainly not Xi.

This is basically the world’s reaction to Donny, the second his back is turned:

Ace job, Donny — .

Face the Nation host Margaret Brennan: “So there were thousands of customers across America, who, when they went to some of the biggest banks, had issues this past week, with tech outages. And it caused a bit of a panic, with people pulling out cash. In this age of AI, what should Americans prepare for, and should they worry about their financial institutions?”

Soybean Scott: “No, they shouldn’t. What we are seeing, as they, because of the SI, as they go into a— patch their security systems, the patches may cause a glitch. which is what happened last week. I think the American people should think of it as a vaccine. Your arm may hurt, you may feel a little bad the next day, but it increases your long-term immunity and resiliency.”

I’m sorry, what? What the fuck kind of screwball analogy is that?

Why even as this smug, haughty bastard even being asked questions about tech? He’s a bean counter. A number cruncher. He doesn’t know shit about software glitches, or what causes them.

Bessent’s job is to cheerlead. He’s never going to tell us the truth. He’s not going to say anything like ‘be fucking terrified, none of us have any clue what’s going on.’

I don’t want be told to relax, and that tech outages are actually good for me. I didn’t vote for this shit. None of us did. We didn’t vote for greedy, arrogant tech bros to inflict their fucked-up visions of janky, six-fingered plagiarism robot overlords on us.

Can’t they just leave us alone? Can’t they and their personal flotation devices just fuck off to their private islands and never be heard from again?

How much fucking money do they need? New kidneys don’t cost much.

Now, as we get into this next story, try not to let your head explode. What I’m about to tell you is a big ball of .

It seems that Donny’s granny-starving Commerce Secretary, Howard Nutlick, was close to getting fired last year, after it came out that he’d visited Epstein Island.

Trump was close to ousting Lutnick earlier this year after Lutnick acknowledged he had visited convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein at his private island, according to people familiar with the matter.

You’ll never guess how Nutlick saved his job. Actually, you will— goddamn it, sorry, I meant to say . Anyway, you will totally believe how LUT-NICK saved his job, — because it involves corruption.

But Lutnick, a billionaire and former chairman of Wall Street firm Cantor Fitzgerald, made a $25 million donation to Trump’s presidential library, and Trump stopped talking about replacing Lutnick, the people said.

So Nutlick saved his job by shoveling twenty-five mill— GODDAMMIT, I did it again. Why do I keep doing that?

So LUT-NICK kept from being fired by shoveling twenty-five million dollars under the table to his boss. As one does, when one is corrupt as fuck.

Remember, Nutlick (fuck it, I’m going to stop correcting myself)— Nutlick is the guy who said that if your granny’s Social Security check fails to show up on time, she should just shut the fuck up about it, because only a scammer would complain about shit like that.

“Let’s say Social Security didn’t send out their checks this month. my mother-in-law, who’s 94, wouldn’t call and complain. She wouldn’t call and complain. she just wouldn’t. She’d think something got messed up, and she’ll get it next month. A fraudster always makes the loudest noise, screaming, yelling, and complaining.”

I have two words for Howard Nutlick. The first one rhymes with and the second rhymes with This out-of-touch gazillionaire has no idea what it’s like to live on a tight budget. If Granny Nutlick’s check doesn’t show up, she can always phone up Howie and ask him to float her a few large, no biggie.

And if Nutlick’s job is on the line because it turns out he’s got his own dead pedo bestie problem, he can just peel twenty-five million off that roll he keeps in his pocket, and hand it off to Dear Leader. As one does, when one is corrupt as fuck.

How much is Nutlick personally raking in from his job as Commerce Secretary, if it’s worth A TWENTY FIVE MILLION DOLLAR BRIBE to keep it?

That’s the question I want the next Democratic Congress to be asking Nutlick, under oath: ‘how much are you grifting off your job?’

What’s really maddening is how the Wall Street Journal normalizes this shit. The gist of their article is basically how awesome Nutlick is at keeping his job. !

The Journal calmly reports on all this as if it ware the most perfectly normal thing in the world — which it is, when Donny and everyone who works for him is corrupt as fuck.

Okay, I need to simmer down. I’m just going to watch Piss-Drunk Pete flip a skateboard up into his own nuts, until the vein in my temple stops throbbing.

Okay, we’re going to need some Daily Claudia right about now.

Look at Ms Spouse and Tenchi the Wonder Cat — , on April 26, 2020.

And here’s another pic of Ms Spouse and her bestie Kathy, in the garden of the restaurant Harvest on Hudson on March 13, 2021.

Fuck it, let’s do one more pic, from September 6, 2019.

Have a great Monday, everyone.

items.title: Preznit Fuckwit has really shitty taste in friends
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Friends. They can be a mixed bag. We’ve all been there, right? I mean, who among us doesn’t have that one bud who can be a little bit — oh, shall we say, ?

Or maybe you’ll be shooting the shit, when all of a sudden he starts a war of choice against Ukraine, one that’s now been dragging on for five years, with no end in sight.

Sure, these kinds of pals can be a handful — some days you just want to go ‘’ — but we keep giving them mulligans, because they’re such irrepressible funsters.

There we all were, once again unwilling participants in the shittiest timeline ever, simply hoping against hope that maybe — — we could go an entire Saturday without having to bear eternal witness to Preznit Fuckwit humiliating himself, and embarrassing our entire country.

No such luck. It’s so exhausting to have to reset this counter every single goddamned day of our lives.

This is so childish. So needy. Imagine having to work this hard to convince the world that not hates your guts.

You know what? It occurs to me that Donny has .

Donny really needs some new buddies — ones who aren’t pedophiles, or war-criming psychopath bastards.

Can’t anyone help hook Donny up? What about the diaper nurse? Doesn’t she know anyone who’d be a good hang for him?

Nah, the bunny boiler wants Dear Leader all to her own. She’s not the sharing type. Look at them, yesterday — golfing together, on the taxpayer dime.

Trump departing the White House this morning for another round of golf. Natalie Harp, in spandex, is tagging along.

When they weren’t canoodling on the 13th green, Donny and Natty were very busy on their crappy app, farting out dozens of posts in the span of an hour or so — most of them variations on the same theme: .

For heaven’s sake, Stalin, Churchill and Roosevelt met in Yalta so they could fight Hitler and the Nazis. Do you think Donny even knows that? I doubt it. All his putrefying pudding-brain can dredge up is ‘famous photo, me want some too.’

Pro tip for Donny: actual leaders don’t have to work this hard to convince the world that they’re leaders. Their accomplishments are all the convincing anyone needs.

But Donny doesn’t have an actual accomplishments to show off. Accomplishments require hard work, and Donny’s too fucking lazy for any of that shit.

Getting your photo taken with your despot besties is its own reward.

Donny’s a cheap grifter and carnival barker. Life to him is just a series of photo ops, so he can be the center of attention, and give the of having gotten shit done.

But nobody but the brain-deadest of his cultists are fooled.

Of course we all know the truth. Putin and Xi aren’t Donny’s friends — and they never will be. They’re taking advantage of a demented old moron, sweet-talking him and then robbing him blind.

Donny’s a mark. He’s getting his pockets picked by two old pros working in cahoots, and he’s too fucking dumb to realize it.

Here’s the other fucked-up thing that happened yesterday, and this one has the diabolical undead hand of Acting President Nosferatu McGoebbels all over it. Donny just ain’t Machiavellian enough to come up with this shit.

President Trump has issued an executive order ordering federal contractors to inform the White House about any congressional requests for information about their work with the government, and withhold any information the government considers confidential.

Basically, this is how Nosferatu imagines he’ll do an end-run around Democrats looking into malfeasance and corruption — by having Donny sign this patently illegal executive order.

The idea being that when next year’s Democratic-led House Oversight Committee asks Donny’s cronies to account for the money spent clownfucking the vulgar Epstein Dance Hall, the cronies will go ‘nuh-uh, we don’t have to tell you. It’s executive privilege.’ Oh, you want to know how the Epstein Reflecting Pool turned into such an over-budget debacle? Fuck you, that shit’s a state secret.

Never mind that executive orders don’t cover contractors. Never mind that it’s Congress’ Constitutionally-mandated to investigate how taxpayer dollars are spent. Nosferatu’s scheme is to tie it all up in courts, for the foreseeable forever.

Come on, do you fuckers really have to pull this shit on a ? Can’t we ever have some peace and quiet around here?

Wouldn’t it be great if it stayed that way? ‘Wouldn’t it be amazing if he went twenty-four whole hours without being a thermonuclear fuckwad? Imagine if my post for tomorrow were simply ‘nothing happened, here’s some Daily Claudia.’

That would fucking rule, wouldn’t it?

Don’t get your hopes up. That ain’t how shitty timelines roll.

And speaking of our Daily Claudia, let’s have some.

Please don’t ask me to explain why Ms Spouse has that garland on her head, because I don’t remember. Just know that it was relevant to whatever event was going on down at our lake on September 12, 2020 — and that Ms Spouse very patiently perched it on her head after a child wandered up and handed it to her.

I think she looks cute as fuck, don’t you?

Have a great Sunday, everyone.

items.title: This Week in Stupid: November 21 edition
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
As another stupid week comes to a close here in America, let’s look back at the dumbest fucking shit that happened.

Monday: exposing imaginary election fraud, for fun and zero profit

Hey, has anyone seen the chopped foam pillow salesman lately? It’s been a while. Should we be sending someone to do a wellness check?

“They were so blatant in what they just did in these midterms. Take all of Texas, all of Kansas, all hundred and five counties. All of Iowa. All across our country. They went overboard. Evil is greedy. And this is where we are gonna win. As you know, the president declassified information that the government was holding from us, about foreign interference in our elections. We need your help.”

Yes, I know. Choppy McPillowface’s elevator no longer goes to the top floor. It hasn’t for a good long while. The deranged Christmas elf inside his head has been leaning on again.

But let’s set that aside for a moment, because there’s something I really want to know:

Where in the hallowed name of Cut-Rate Lodging Jesus is Mike Lindell broadcasting from?

Look at his surroundings. Some shitty floor lamp. A nondescript chair, next to a simple table and a bed. The worst drapes ever. Holy fuck, Mike’s been reduced to staying in cheap motels, hasn’t he?

Didn’t this jamoke used to be some kind of millionaire CEO?

Why is he now holed up in Four Seasons Total Motelling, across the street from the topless joint with the all-you-can-eat buffet, on the outskirts of town?

Bro, it’s time to pick a better grift. Begging MAGA for their spare change so you can prove imaginary election fraud ain’t floating the boat.

Here’s Rachel Campos-Duffy, spouse of the Secretary In Charge Of Making Sure Planes Don’t Fucking Fall Out Of The Sky, with some super-reassuring news.

“If anything happens, we all go up to Wisconsin, where we have fresh water, we have guns and lots of ammo.”

Wait a second, the Duffys are ?

Excuse me, but that’s not how it’s supposed to work. When shit goes sideways, the moron whose incompetence that shit go sideways isn’t supposed to have a place to hide from all the sideways shit. He’s supposed to stay at his desk, straightening that shit out.

These nitwits are stockpiling guns and ammo out in the middle of nowhere? Great, what could go wrong?

Oh, by the way, here’s some footage of Sean Duffy, up there in Wisconsin, doing his doomsday prepping.

I swear, these MAGA shitwits have no shame. I can’t wait for Duff’s final press conference — the one where he goes ‘sorry we broke everything. Sucks to be you,’ as he closes the hatch to his shelter.

Thanks for nothing, asshole.

Wednesday: just another mystery from the dawn of time

“When is the last time you saw a conservative riot? Conservatives really don’t know how to riot. We lack the blueprint for it.”

Hmm. I’m trying to jog my memory about the last time conservatives rioted. It’s right there on the tip of my tongue.

Maybedudes know. Hey guys, can I ask you a question? When was the last time conservatives rioted? Have they ever? Guys?

Ah, they seem too preoccupied by whatever hijinks they’re doing to reply. Oh well.

Hey, can we get Josh Hawley in here? Maybe he knows the answer.

Apparently no, we can’t get Josh in here. He seems to be in a real hurry to get somewhere.

What about Markwayne Mullin? Hey, Mark?

It looks like Marky Two-names is too busy looking for whatever he dropped to answer. I wonder why he looks so terrified. Huh.

Oh well, I guess we’ll never find out if conservatives have ever rioted. It’s just going to be one of those unsolved mysteries for the ages.

Thursday: just fuck off,

Florida GOP Rep Randy Fine: “Look, if Americans want to elect a former bartender as their president, then that’s up to them, but I think we need people who have had to be successful in the real world, who have gone out and done things and understand how you start, build, and grow a family. How you start, build and grow a business.”

Fuck straight off into the sea, Randy — if that even is your real name.

Folks, get ready to hear this every goddamned day for the next two years. ‘AOC was a bartenders. Girl bartenders can’t be president. They don’t know how to run a business.’

After her father’s death, AOC tended bar to help prevent foreclosure on her parent’s house. Bartenders encounter a wide variety of people with a wide variety of perspectives. AOC earned a Bachelor of Arts (BA) degree, double-majoring in international relations and economics. So why is Fine sneering at AOC?.

Oh, and speaking of some fucking idiot—

Friday: the further adventures of Some Fucking Idiot™

On Friday, instead of hiding in shame after his traitorous escapade in China, some fucking idiot actually had the temerity to take a victory lap. Flanked by his Emotional Support Flunkies, Couchfuck McGee and Liddle Marco Big-Shoes, the fucking idiot actually bragged about not giving a shit about America.

COLLINS: You said Putin is your friend. Russia is Iran’s biggest ally. Do you believe Putin is a friend to America?

TRUMP: I can't speak to America

The fucking idiot can’t speak to America? Does the fucking idiot remember which country he’s supposed to be president of?

Oh my god, the fucking idiot wants a cookie. He thinks he deserves a cookie, after shitting the bed and then rolling around in the mess. Fuck off, you don’t get a cookie.

as Marco Rubio squirms behind him, Trump whines about not getting a Nobel Prize

Trump: “Before I was here, I had a plane — I had a very nice life — and my pilot would use the air traffic control from a totally different country ... I don’t want to say the country.”

What the fuck? That’s not how air traffic control works. There’s no concierge service where you get to pick and choose which one you want. The pilots communicate with the tower that’s closest to their plane at any given moment. Does the fucking idiot even know what planet he’s on right now?

Trump says not to worry about all the tech outages lately because he has a very good understanding of what’s going on with the technology because of his uncle and it probably passed on to him genetically, too.

Now, could the diaper nurse please take the fucking idiot to the dentist and get his dentures adjusted? Because the fucking idiot kept making gross slurping noises the entire time. Listen to this.

Yeah, the fucking idiot slurped his way through the entire presser. Ew.

And, of course, it wouldn’t be a White House press conference if the fucking idiot wasm’t rude to some reporter.

TRUMP: Come on. Who are you with?

REPORTER: I’m with NBC, sir

TRUMP: You're really a rude person. I’m not talking to you. You shouldn’t be in the front row. You should be in the back row.

And, as always, even though the fucking idiot had just treated them like shit, right to their faces, not one reporter stood up to ask, ‘what the fuck is wrong with you?’

How fucking idiotic is that?

And now, let’s put a close to This Week in Stupid and reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia.

Here’s Katie and her mom, in some undated photos that were taken at our old house in Hastings. Katie looks, what, 7 or 8 years old? That would make these photos from 1998 or 1999.

Oh my god,

Have a non-stupid Saturday, everyone.

items.title: Is MAGA cracking up, or having a nervous breakdown? Who gives a shit, let’s just enjoy their bitter tears
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
MAGA-on-MAGA violence — it’s what’s for breakfast.

In the wake of the disastrous midterms, the worst fucking people in the world all have their long knives out right now — and these magnificent morons are getting stabby on the best possible targets: each other.

So let’s all microwave some popcorn, settle in, and enjoy the carnage.

Nosferatu McGoebbels hates the shit out of Marky Two-Names

The undead White House Chief of Staff is very very mad at the failed plumber’s assistant right now.

It’s all about .

MULLIN ON OUTAGES: “I talked to one guy in the tech industry, he asked not to mention his name, it’s not Elon. I asked, what could be causing these outages? He said I believe it's SI, because these programs aren’t designed to work as fast as SI is. So when they put in a program that’s able to write codes and it goes in and self-fixes, as it starts to self-fix itself it like a change order on a house. That kind of makes sense to me.”

For all we know, Marky just committed an honesty. is a vastly more logical explanation of what could bring down an entire system, than the ‘it was this one ferkaktah router’ line the rest of the administration has been spouting.

Nonetheless, when Nosferatu got wind of what Marky’d said on Hannity, he got so upset that he choked on the bat he’d been eating.

Oh, no — anything but that! The horror.

Brian Kilmeade hates the shit out of Couckfuck McGee

Fox’s Brian Kilmeade goes scorched earth on JD Vance: “He never should have been vice president.”

Wow, what did Couchfuck say to set off Kilmeade? It must have been a doozy, right?

“But my prediction, Laura, is that whatever the president ultimately decides to do, there are going to be people who demand more, who want the war to go on indefinitely,” Vance said.

The vice president insisted there was “no daylight” between himself and Trump on the issue, adding that the president “is not going to let this become a forever war.”

Couchfuck didn’t accuse of wanting the war to go on. But there’s built-up resentment here, because Vance has decided that his path to the Republican presidential nomination in 2028 is to be the ‘I would have never gone into Iran’ candidate. He’d been making noises to that effect recently — and that shit absolutely will not fly with the ‘Dear Leader is never wrong’ crowd.

So it doesn’t matter how JD’s now fine-tuning his remarks. The crime has already been committed. So of course Kilmeade was going to go ballistic.

And also of course, MAGA is crashing out right now. They’re losing their minds over the midterms. They don’t want . So you can go fuck yourself, Mister Couchfuck McGee, if that even is your real name. Fuck straight off with your stupid

Hey, guess what I have in my pocket for Brian Kilmeade — and Nosferatu McGoebbels as well, and all these Donnyverse dumbfucks who are so very very sad-mad right now.

It’s the world’s tiniest violin!

Of course, Couchfuck has been sniffing glue if he imagines he has path to the presidency in 2028, but that’s an entire different discussion for another day.

The entire MAGAverse hates the shit out of John Thune

JOHN THUNE JUST NOW: “Any exit poll that you look at would tell you it was about the war, it was about the economy, it was about inflation, it was about gas prices...none of which any of our candidates had much control over.”

We lost nine Senate seats because @LeaderJohnThune is retarded.

Have you noticed a pattern here? The entire MAGAverse can’t handle hearing the truth right now. Not from Marky Two-Names, not from Couchfuck McGee, and certainly some piece of shit senator, droning on about and and . They just want to rage and vent — oh, and they want a scapegoat. Check that, they don’t just want a scapegoat. They

What a load of crap. The outcome of the midterms were because of Everyone being sick of @LeaderJohnThune sitting on HUNDREDS of bills the House already passed, but HE refused to allow the senate to vote on.

Remember, Dear Leader can never fail. He can only And this time, he’s being failed by John Thune, because .

Hey, all you MAGAverse whiners taking it out on John Thune — I have something here for you, too.

Eat binky, you crybaby losers. Sucks to be you.

Dinesh D’Ipshit and the Nazi Incel hate the shit out of each other.

Who even cares? Lets just enjoy these two tiresome shitwits wailing on each other.

Now let’s have our Hero of the Day — Democratic Senator Richard Blumenthal.

All this week, the good Senator has been making fools of Donny’s nominees, by asking them simple questions. Questions like ‘who won the 2020 election?’ and ‘was there an attack on the Capitol on January 6th?’ Of course, none of these nominees can give an honest answer, for fear of angering the Audience of One, watching back in the Oval Bordello.

Senator Blumenthal: “Mr. LoSapio, who won the popular vote in 2020, in the presidential election?”

Michael LoSapio: “I’m— I’m not going to answer the question about an election six years ago. What I’m here to answer—”

Blumenthal: “You’re in charge of election security, correct?”

LoSapio:

Blumenthal: “You’re supposed to look at the facts. And you’re supposed to tell us the facts.”

Blumenthal: “I’m asking you a factual question.”

LoSapio: “I’m— my only involvement in the 2020 election was voting for the president of the United States.”

Blumenthal: “You’re ducking the question, in a way that betrays your lack of independence and objectivity. Those qualities are essential to the role that you are going to play. Are you going to answer the question or not?”

LoSapio:

Blumenthal: “You are disqualified from the position that you have been nominated to fill.”

Holy shit. Imagine being this proud of being this neutered, in fealty to Dear Leader.

Mr. LoSapio, as a consolation prize, would you like a tiny violin, or a binky? Oh, you won’t answer? Fine, I’ll chose for you. Here you go.

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

Here’s Ms Spouse doing a little gardening on May 26, 2016.

And here she is on the patio, waiting for her devoted husband to finish making Sunday brunch, on September 30, 2018.

And here she is, June 1, 2011.

Have a great Friday, everyone.

items.title: Shh! Don’t wake Preznit Fuckwit — international geopolitics makes him sleepy
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
That’s right, the narcoleptic old fart factory’s brain went again yesterday, right in the middle of an APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in China.

But before we get to that —

This is just so fucking bizarre. Are we all on crazy pills right now?

How creepy is this? Why is she there? She has no legitimate function in that room. How does this keep happening, in meeting after meeting? Does she simply invite herself along, and no one says ?

Imagine you’re a world leader, sitting across the table from all that. How could you even concentrate, with that spectacle going on? What do you say to your spouse when you get home? ‘You will never fucking believe what happened today. The silly dipshit brought a date

You know what? Let’s skip over the question of why is Natty there, because here’s a better question: Why is there?

What value does presence add? All he does is ramble incoherently about his own imaginary accomplishments, and piss and moan if he doesn’t get a toy.

“There’s never been a time like this. But of course it was— right here— in this [unintelligible] palace that President— Quezon bestowed General Douglas MacArthur with a gold— baton, and the rank of Field Marshall in the Philippine Army. I’d like to have you do that for me, if you don’t mind. I’d love that. I mean, why the hell shouldn’t I get that?”

Yeah, come on, President Marcos, get with the program. Don’t you know by now that Donny always gets a participation trophy, no matter where he goes? FIFA gave him one. So did NASA. So give the whiny little piss-baby his fucking gold baton before he falls to pieces, like a child in a supermarket who can’t have candy.

Seriously, what’s the point of even having Donny there at your meeting? My advice to every international organization — APEC, the Quad, NATO, the G7, the United Nations, the OAS, — is this: the next time you hold a wingding, don’t bother inviting Donny. I promise that you won’t even notice his absence, except for maybe air quality having been improved by the lack of narcoleptic farts.

After Dear Leader shit the bed in the Philippines, it was on to China, where Donny was serenely unaware that he was the mark.

“They’re treating me extremely well for China, and I have a lot of respect and a good relationship with President Xi ... nobody is gonna play games with us.”

Oh my god, this gullible goofus has no idea he was being set up to be swindled. He’s so easily manipulated that it isn’t even funny. the Chinese are treating him ‘extremely well’ — they’re buttering him up so they can pick his pockets.

Donny is like the chump at the blackjack table in a Las Vegas casino. He’s losing his shirt, but all he can do is marvel over how they keep giving him free drinks.

Donny:

Fox bobblehead: “Are you going to tell them to stop buying Iranian oil?”

Donny: “You know, when they say that China is working with— with uh, Iran, or Russia’s working with Iran, no, no. What, they’re giving some information? We have all the information that they give. We know exactly what they’re giving. It’s peanuts.”

Hang on, did Dear Leader just hand-wave away China and Russia feeding intel to Iran, because ? He did, didn’t he. What in the actual fuck?

Look, it’s not just that’s being provided to Iran. China is Iran’s largest buyer of crude oil. Russia is helping Iran re-arm itself. Do you imagine that Donny doesn’t know that, or just doesn’t care, because — as he so idiotically puts it — I can’t decide which scenario is worse. What a great idea it was, to let a greedy and easily-flattered shit-for-brains be president.

Tell me, is allowing our adversaries to get away with aiding a country we’re at war with, because you expect you’ll personally benefit from doing so — would that be a

I’m hopeful that we’ll find out at Donny’s third impeachment trial, next year.

Now I can hear you out there, going ‘but Uncle Jeff, what about the Nodfather? You promised at the top of this post that Donny would be sleeping.’

Yes, I know I did, but we had to get through the boring-but-more-important stuff first. Don’t make me come over there and explain how clickbait works.

Holy fuck, Dear Leader is out like a light. He doesn’t move a millimeter during the entire clip. The only way to tell that you’re not looking at a still photograph is that you can see Soybean Scott Bessent’s smug haughty head moving in the background, behind Donny.

Who thought it would be a good idea to let a doddering demento attend four meetings across two countries in one day?

I have an idea. Can we get that Arlington Guard back in here, to stand behind Donny and scream ‘ALL PRESIDENTS WILL MAINTAIN AN ATMOSPHERE OF NOT FALLING THE FUCK ASLEEP AND EMBARRASSING YOUR ENTIRE COUNTRY’?

Because that would fucking rule.

And now, on to our Daily Claudia.

Here are two photos taken in Plymouth, MA, back in the early 1990s, by Daughter Katie. This first one is from before she was old enough to have figured out that whole ‘don’t crop people’s heads off’ thing.

And this second one, thankfully, is from after.

Have a great Thursday, everyone.

Oh wait — one final thing before I let you go.

I have no idea what this unsubscriber means by ‘too much porn type stuff.’ Is it the cussing? Folks, I hope you’re all reading these posts and discovering that I have a sweary fucking mouth you plunk down your hard-earned cash on a paid subscription.

Oh, and don’t be fooled by all the free drinks at the blackjack table.

Okay, you can all fucking well have a great fucking Thursday.

items.title: What the fuck is on Dear Leader’s head?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Seriously, what in the actual fuck?

The Donny we all saw heading for Bribe Force One yesterday morning was the one we’re all familiar with: the belligerent racist moron with the rat’s nest of yellow piss-mop hair atop his big, dumb pumpkin head.

Sure, because nothing says ‘I’m a dignified world leader’ more than wrapping one’s misshapen body in a cheap misshapen suit, gazing at the world through dull, vacant eyes, standing like a toddler who just planted a fresh load into its pull-ups, and spastically waving two child-size flags held in two child-sized fists.

And, of course, the shit-emoji hair.

Who thought this was a good idea? Let me guess. It was the bunny-boiling diaper nurse. Looking up from the notebook where she’d devoted the last two hours to scrawling over and over and over, she said, ‘Sir! Sir! I know how we can make you even more handsome! Sir!’, and pulled a tube of Grecian Formula out of her diaper bag.

It happened because there are no adults left in the room. With the last responsible human being, Susie Wiles, banished to that big farm upstate where she now has lots of room to run around, it’s just Donny, the diaper nurse and and Acting President Nosferatu McGoebbels — and he could give a fuck what Donny and Natty get up to, as long as they leave him alone to actually run the country.

So that’s why, while the entire world goes to shit all around us, and, one by one, the online services we’ve come to depend on go , the topic of the day aboard Bribe Force One was Natty going, ‘you know what be cool? Let’s do you up like a poopsicle.’

“It’s life. When you’re big and powerful and have all the money, things like that happen — it’s fine.”

I’m sorry, but what the fuck kind of answer is ? No, it’s not fine. It’s only if you’re a privileged moron who lives in a pampered bubble, has all his needs taken care of for him, and jets around in a vulgar flying bordello that some emirs bribed him with.

Let’s do this. Let’s imagine it’s 2023, and Joe Biden is president. Let’s say all the planes are grounded, you can’t get into your email, and your online banking app won’t work. Now let’s imagine that Biden, brown crap smeared all over his head, shows up goes,

Do you think the worthless scribblers of the corporate-controlled press would have accepted that answer, and just gone ‘well I guess it’s fine, if Joe says so’?

Absolutely not. They would have roasted Biden alive.

Now imagine that Biden had pulled out a couple of flags and started waving them around like a meth-tweaked mental patient.

Jake Tapper would have personally taken it upon himself to burn the White House to the ground.

Meanwhile, back on Planet Earth, the Senate was holding a confirmation hearing for Acting Navy Secretary, Hung Cao. But let me back up a bit, and fill you in on how Hung Cao came to be our acting head of the Navy.

“It’s really an honor to be with you,” Trump said with Cao to his right. “Thank you. And we’re gonna be with this man. This is a great gentleman. I love his name — Hung Cao. I love that name. And that name alone should get you elected, right?”

Spoiler alert: Hung Cao’s name get him elected in 2024, because Hung Cao is a fucking crackpot who ran for Senate because, quite frankly,

“There’s a place in Monterey, California called Lovers Point. The original name was Lovers of Christ Point. But now they took out the Christ, it’s become Lovers Point — really, Monterey is a really dark place now, a lot of witchcraft and the wiccan community has really taken over there, and we can’t let that happen in Virginia.”

Hung Cao seems sane, doesn’t he?

And because Donny has a knack for always being able to find the worst person possible for each job, he plucked Wytchfinder Cao from the shitpile of failure and made him his Undersecretary of the Navy.

For once in his entire stupid life, Donny didn’t hire a flunkie because he looked good on Fox News. No, this time he picked the dude whose name makes him think of a .

And now, Cao — the scourge of witches from Monterey to Virginia — is our Acting Secretary of the Navy.

Mark Kelly: “So are you saying the reports of sailors losing 45 pounds are not true?”

Hung Cao: “It’s just not what they want. It’s like my kids opening up the refrigerator door and saying, ‘there’s nothing to eat here.’”

Kelly: “Somebody doesn’t lose 45 pounds just because they don’t like the options. I don’t think that’s a fair assessment.”

Are you fucking kidding me? What kind of answer is, ‘yeah, these sailors are just picky eaters.’

In any fair world, Cao would have immediately been transported to a ship in the middle of the ocean and been forced to eat rotting food for eight months. And then if he said anything about it, we could just go ‘shut the fuck up and stop being a prima donna.’

It’s stunning how not one of these Donnyverse sewer clowns can ever just simply say ‘yeah, we fucked up. We’ll do better next time,’

I guess he realized he .

Peltola won with 50.1% of the vote. That’s more than both Dan Sullivans combined, so Preznit Fuckwit and Attorney General Muggsy and all the whiners in the MAGAsphere can sit on it and twirl.

Now let’s have us our Daily Claudia.

Today’s curation comes courtesy of the Google Photos app, which, for some reason, all on its own and without my prompting, took it upon itself to send me a link to a collection it created and called ‘Claudia eads.’ Here’s some of what it picked.

In the living room on February 14, 2016.

On the patio on August 30, 2016.

In the living room on January 1, 2017.

In the back yard on May 7, 2020.

And at Blu Pointe in Newburgh, on January 30, 2025.

Have a great Wednesday, everyone. I could get used to having Google’s janky curation robot do my work for me. Hey bro, you want to write tomorrow’s post?
